claims.author: taki-abedesselam
claims.harm: The new check runs after the nTime refresh, causing genuinely newer announcements to be blocked whenever the refresh fires.
claims.quote: the new check runs *after* the `nTime` refresh above it, which sets `pinfo->nTime = addr.nTime - time_penalty`. So whenever that refresh fires, the check becomes `addr.nTime - time_penalty <= addr.nTi

claims.author: danielabrozzoni
claims.quote: I think it would be nice to at least have some documentation around this, and the current "do not update if no new information is present" comment is not very explicative
claims.request: Clarify and document the intended behavior around updating timestamps versus increasing multiplicity in AddSingle.

claims.author: frankomosh
claims.quote: Besides checking that relayed duplicates don’t add buckets, maybe we could also check that a relayed newer announcement still can.
claims.request: Add a test checking that a relayed newer announcement can still add buckets / bump multiplicity.

claims.author: fametrano
claims.harm: A relayed announcement more than an hour newer than the previous one can no longer add a bucket, keeping nodes that announce daily at multiplicity 1.
claims.quote: One issue should be fixed before merge: on 5f58a43fd7, a relayed announcement more than an hour newer than the previous one can no longer add a bucket, so a node that announces itself once a day stays at multiplicity 1.
